newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Bell up on contract news. [CORRECTED 22:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Bell up on contract news. [CORRECTED 22:57 GMT]

text.p: Cincinnati Bell Inc shares closed up 2-3/8 to 49-3/8 on Thursday after the company's information systems unit announced late Wednesday an AT&T Corp contract extension for cellular billing services, a spokesman and an analyst said.
Asked if the stock was up due to the company's statement on the contract, spokesman Wayne Buckhout said, "That is the only news the company has issued in the last 24 hours."
Analyst Bette Massick Colombo of Bear Stearns & Co said the news probably boosted the stock but also said the stock "has been rather weak over the last couple of days."
The contract extends an additional two years, through 2001, Cincinnati Bell Information Systems' contract to handle cellular telephone billing for AT&T Wireless Services Inc.
Buckhout said negotiations continue on another significant AT&T contract, with Cincinnati Bell's local telephone company unit, for long-distance telephone services (corrects description of contract).
